title: Paris
text: Paris is the capital of France and home to the Eiffel Tower.

title: Berlin
text: Berlin is the capital of Germany and was divided during the Cold War.

title: Rome
text: Rome is the capital of Italy and was the center of the Roman Empire.

title: Madrid
text: Madrid is the capital of Spain and hosts the Prado Museum.

title: Lisbon
text: Lisbon is the capital of Portugal on the Atlantic coast.

title: Ottawa
text: Ottawa is the capital of Canada, not Toronto.

title: Canberra
text: Canberra is the capital of Australia, not Sydney.

title: Brasilia
text: Brasilia is the capital of Brazil, planned in the 1950s.

title: Cairo
text: Cairo is the capital of Egypt near the Nile River.

title: Tokyo
text: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and one of the largest metro areas.

title: New Delhi
text: New Delhi is the capital of India.

title: Beijing
text: Beijing is the capital of China.

title: Nairobi
text: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya in East Africa.

title: Ankara
text: Ankara is the capital of Turkey, while Istanbul is the largest city.

title: Vienna
text: Vienna is the capital of Austria and birthplace of many composers.

title: Albert Einstein
text: Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity.

title: Marie Curie
text: Marie Curie pioneered research on radioactivity and won two Nobel Prizes.

title: Isaac Newton
text: Isaac Newton formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation.

title: Ada Lovelace
text: Ada Lovelace wrote early notes on Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine.

title: Alan Turing
text: Alan Turing founded concepts of modern computation and Turing machines.

title: Tourism notes
text: Many capital cities attract tourists with museums, parks, and historic districts.
